- **T? [owner] The outing's "Through green" names a journey of views with no green stop** (2026-11-25)
  Area: outing. Seen: `src/lib/outing/leanings.ts` l.16 (`{ id: 'green', name: 'Through green', chips: ['parks', 'viewpoints'] }`): with only "Views & oddities" on, the journey is titled "Through green" over three "A view or an oddity" stops (picture: the outing journey's `tend-explore-T63-town-320`); main does the same (the T63 review: ux U3, steward Silent 1). Rests on: `docs/research/ui-references.md` section 1.13, H2 ("Use words, phrases, and concepts familiar to the user").
  Recommended: the leaning is named for what it holds, parks and views together, in words the owner picks, pictured at 320 px on the journey card and the opened journey's title. /vision: aligned (Earn: a journey's name says what it holds; words only, no rank, count or measure).
  Precedent: none found (the leanings are their own list, `leanings.ts`, OJ17-OJ18).
  Otherwise: viewpoints get a leaning of their own, or leave it.

- **OJ21's "as the chips' own words", and OJ23, after `tend explore T63` and audits 50-54** (Nov 25; the owner's yes in person to T63, 2026-11-24, "T63 as a quick batch (Recommended)"; decisions 0239 and 0264). What ships: the outing's "viewpoints" chip and its spoken name read the one table's name, "Views & oddities"; a card's summary and the town line take each chip's word for a sentence (`chipWord`, `lib/outing/chips.ts`), the kind's noun, so they still read "Views" ("Around here. Views. 745 m on foot.", "Views here."), as decision 0264 has sentences keep the noun. Still saying the old: `specs/outing-journey/spec.md` OJ21 (l.164), a card's summary "as the chips' own words"; suggested: "…what it includes by kind, in each chip's word for a sentence (a kind's noun from the one table, a shop chip's label)…"; and OJ23 (l.173), which builds the town line "only from a closed table of the atlas's own words" (the code's note on it said "as the chips' own words", reworded in tend explore audit 53): the same rewording, if the owner wants the town line's words named there too. The loop never edits a spec; the specs mirror the owner's doc: reword there and re-export.

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, at its narrowest width and at the largest text size, open "Plan an outing", pick a place or "Nowhere in particular", and switch "Views & oddities" on and off; with VoiceOver, then TalkBack, move through the chips; with only "Views & oddities" on, read a journey card and open it. **Expect:** the chips stay one alphabetical list, "Views & oddities" last, whole (it may wrap inside its pill at the largest text, nothing lost or cut, none over another); the screen reader says "Views & oddities" plainly and its selected state; the card's summary and the town line say "Views", never "Views & oddities" (`tend explore T63`, audits 50-53).
